svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY: a cassette, its index card, its J-card and the edge of a tape deck
svg.desc: A translucent orange cassette labelled ULTRA-SATISFACTORY with turning reels, an index card listing twelve recipes as tracks whose running times are their craft cycle times, and an opened J-card: flap with the counts (140 items, 211 recipes, 477 buildings, 5 phases), navy spine, and a sunset front cover with an obi strip. Along the bottom, the top edge of a tape deck with a three-digit counter that adds up the craft seconds played on this side, and a two-row level meter.
